entries.o: <fe><02><0a><35><39><32><62><5f><30><30><34><37><00>I don't think anyone cares\nabout the icicle.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><32><62><5f><30><30><35><32><00>Just looking at the icicle\nmakes me cold...
<fe><02><0a><35><39><32><62><5f><30><30><35><39><00>I guess my swordsmanship\ncould use some work.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><32><62><5f><30><30><36><32><00>I'm afraid of what Cierra\nwill do if I touch it again...
<fe><02><0a><35><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>It might have something\nto do with the Accursed.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>I guess we'll have to\nsee for ourselves.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>It's not natural. I'm\nsure magic was involved.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>I wouldn't play around\nwith magic like that...
<fe><02><0a><35><39><33><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>There's ice in the ice with\na lotta ice iced on that ice!
<fe><02><0a><35><39><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>So the ice is ice, this is\nice, and inside ice, ummm...
<fe><02><0a><35><39><34><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Th-There's no other choice.\nWe have to fight!

A ghost town in
northeastern Riviera.
An underground
catacomb lies
beneath it.

A dark path leading
toward the cemetery's
underground caverns.
Torches illuminate
the path.

The Pilgrimage Way
leads to this ivy
infested area. There
are two entrances:
north and south.

The names of the
Six Great Priests
of Mireno are eternally
engraved in the Ankhs.<fe><00>Their hands opened
the Holy Land<fc><4a>
their names sealed
off the path.<fe><00>Until the Six Priests
meet again...

A large lake of
collected rain water.
The clarity makes it
appear shallow, but
it's actually quite deep.

Xenon, Lokin
and Askus rest
in this section
of the catacombs.

Yumel, Iduna
and Teula rest
in this part of
the catacombs.

Giant crystals stand
within each sacred
shrine, silently
illuminating the
darkness.

The Red Altar...
     
Dost thou seek new paths?
     
Then name for me...
     
...the priest of fire!

The Blue Altar...
     
Dost thou seek new paths?
     
Then name for me...
     
...the priest of ice!

The Yellow Altar...
     
Dost thou seek new paths?
     
Then name for me...
     
...the priest of lightning!

The holy land of death
that lies beyond the
lake. Poisonous air
leads visitors to their
untimely deaths.

A dungeon deep below
the ground, unknown
to man. What secrets
does this forsaken
maze hide?
<fe><02><0a><36><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>There's even sunlight...\nThis is really inside a tree?
<fe><02><0a><36><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Ledah is somewhere here.\nWe have to stop him.
<fe><02><0a><36><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>We have to catch up before\nthe Retribution is started!
<fe><02><0a><36><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>But what're ya gonna do\nwhen you catch up?
<fe><02><0a><36><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Run! If they catch you,\nwho knows what'll happen!

<fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>I hear Yggdrasil has its
own defense mechanism.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>These Sprites, the Cefiro,
are part of that system.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>The defenses must've been
activated.
<fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Looks like they won't let\nus pass without a fight.
<fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>I-If you eat us, Ursula\nwill beat you up!
<fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><31><00>The jig is up! Those wings\nand ugly face are proof.
<fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>They attack everything,\nso we were running away.
<fe><02><0a><36><31><34><62><5f><30><30><35><30><00>We'll hide inside your\nclothes, so be careful.
<fe><02><0a><36><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>There's no way all this\ncan be inside a tree...
<fe><02><0a><36><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>We must be careful. We're\ndealing with the Cefiro.
<fe><02><0a><36><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>We have no choice but to\ndefeat them.
<fe><02><0a><36><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>This block's unsteady.\nIt shakes when I do this.
<fe><02><0a><36><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>If we stomp on it, it'll\nprolly give way.
<fe><02><0a><36><32><34><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Come to think of it, they\nARE about the same size...
<fe><02><0a><36><33><32><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The floatin' blocks here\nlook like they fell apart.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><32><63><5f><30><30><30><31><00>It shows that this place is\neven older than we thought.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Huh? Oh... Sorry, Fia. I was\nthinking about something.

<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><61><5f><30><30><31><34><00>We have traveled with you\nof our own will,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><33><33><61><5f><30><30><31><35><00>and we have experienced\nmany trials with you.

<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><61><5f><30><30><31><36><00>But you're always off in\nyour own world.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><33><33><61><5f><30><30><31><37><00>You never share what's\nreally bothering you...
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><61><5f><30><30><33><30><00>but I've always believed\nthat our journey was fate.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><61><5f><30><30><33><34><00>If you weren't there that\ntime, I'd still be alone.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>There's nowhere to go but\ndown, it seems.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Where are we? I don't see\nany paths around here...
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>How dare you set foot in\nthis sacred sanctuary!
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>These are the growth rings\nof the tree.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>Is this your first time\nseeing them, Serene?
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>You can tell its age\nby looking at these rings.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>But why was it cut? Did\nLedah or the Cefiro do it?

<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Neither.  This forest is 
well taken care of.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>If the trees are too
close together,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>they'll steal each other's
nutrients and die.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>So if they get too close,\nthey chop the older tree.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>Selectin' who lives and\nwho dies... just like...
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><63><5f><30><30><30><35><00>We don't have any time.\nWe must find Ledah!
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><63><5f><30><30><30><36><00>There's a big stump that\nwe could jump on to.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><63><5f><30><30><30><37><00>But it looks like we can't\ncome back if we did.

<fe><02><0a><36><33><33><63><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Yggdrasil is an enclosed\narea full of trees.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><33><33><63><5f><30><30><31><30><00>That may make it susceptible\nto wind phenomena.
<fe><02><0a><36><33><31><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>I will slay all who oppose\nthe will of the gods.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><31><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>This platform is moving\nsideways ever so slightly.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><32><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>This area seems much more\nlevel than the one before.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><32><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>It seems the trees are\navoiding certain spots.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><32><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Each tree follows the will\nof Yggdrasil, huh...
<fe><02><0a><36><34><32><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>It's lower than here, so we\ncan't come back if we go.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><32><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>I guess that platform\nwould be the outside one.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><32><63><5f><30><30><30><36><00>It's too far down for us to\nclimb back up here.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><33><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Wha? That's kinda random.\nWhere'd that come from?
<fe><02><0a><36><34><33><61><5f><30><30><31><38><00>It looks like there's no\nturning back after this.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Maybe I could use that\nrock we picked up...
<fe><02><0a><36><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Then all that's left is\nto force our way through!
<fe><02><0a><36><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>If it doesn't notice us,\nwe should just move along.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><33><63><5f><30><30><30><37><00>We must defeat them in\norder to pass.
<fe><02><0a><36><34><34><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>To tell you the truth,\nI really don't know.
<fe><02><0a><36><35><31><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>This is also part of\nYggdrasil, I see.

<fe><02><0a><36><35><31><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>The wind is so strong...\nI can barely open my eyes.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><35><31><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Now's not the time to be\nlooking around.
<fe><02><0a><36><35><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I came to Elendia as a\nGrim Angel...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><35><32><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>But I never imagined it\nwould end up like this.

<fe><02><0a><36><35><32><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>I may have no wings, but\nI have Einherjar.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><35><32><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>I believe in my purpose\nand will move ahead!
<fe><02><0a><36><35><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Thanks, Rose. That means\na lot, coming from you.
<fe><02><0a><36><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>You shall not lay a finger\non the Aquarium.

<fe><02><0a><36><35><31><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>The wind is so strong,\nI can barely open my eyes.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><35><31><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Now's not the time to be\nlooking around.

<fe><02><0a><36><35><31><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Destroy the Aquariums and\nactuate the Retribution...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><35><31><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>No one else shall\naccomplish that...
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>If only we had something\nfrom that time period...
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>It's simple once we figure\nout the grammar.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Something is sealed away\ninside to protect it.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>I'm not confident I can,\nbut I'll do my best.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>It was because the seal\nwas already weak.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein, what kind of job do\nyou do as a Grim Angel?
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><63><5f><30><30><33><36><00>You don't want an upgrade?\nIt's your choice.

<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><63><5f><30><30><33><37><00>I have a favor to ask you.\nTake me with you.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><32><63><5f><30><30><33><38><00>I feel so helpless--\nI mean--I wanna come, too!
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><63><5f><30><30><34><38><00>What!? I just powered up\nyour sword for you!
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><63><5f><30><30><35><32><00>I have a bad feeling about\nthis chest...
<fe><02><0a><36><36><32><63><5f><30><30><35><33><00>I'm waiting for the enemy,\nso don't bother me!
<fe><02><0a><36><36><33><61><5f><30><30><31><34><00>Thanks. I'll heal you as\na token of my appreciation.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><33><63><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Ein, there's a beautiful\njewel in the water.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><33><63><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Are you sure you want to\ngive it to me?

<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><30><37><00>The Aquariums are the units
that protect Yggdrasil...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><30><38><00>I've already destroyed the
first and second unit.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>There's only one remaining...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><31><30><00>There will be no one to
stop the Retribution.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><31><33><00>Ledah, there's no need for\nthe Retribution anymore!
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><31><39><00>You were after such petty\nthings as that?

<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><32><34><00>They merely trigger the demon's\nactivities<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><32><35><00>and the Sprites' souls flow to\nthe one who governs death.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><32><37><00>Collecting souls. That has\nalways been our objective.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><33><31><00>Then what about my friends\nin eternal slumber?
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><33><34><00>Ein, stop deceiving\nyourself!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><33><35><00>The gods decide the role of\nthe Sprites, not us angels.

<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><33><38><00>I will fight to protect all
of my friends!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><33><39><00>It doesn't matter whether
I'm an angel or not!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><34><30><00>Even if I'm going against
the gods, I will fight!
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><34><32><00>Without the Aquariums,\nUrsula will be unprotected.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><34><33><00>And Riviera will be\nfinished.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><34><35><00>Knowing you, you will catch\nup, no matter what happens...
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><35><30><00>Tch... I never imagined I'd\nlose to you in battle...
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><35><35><00>What are you talking about?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><35><36><00>That is the most practical\naction to take... in battle...
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><36><33><00>I'm sure he's happy to have\nbeen done in by an angel.
<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><37><33><00>With my Diviner, Skadi,\nI am sworn to Master Hector.

<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><37><34><00>In order to revive the
golden age of the gods...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><37><35><00>Someone must become the
one and only god.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><37><36><00>Only then will Asgard gain
eternal power.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><37><37><00>That is what my master said,
and his word is absolute.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><37><38><00>I started collecting souls
at Rosalina Island...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><37><39><00>All for the sake of Asgard...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><38><30><00>We have no need for a Grim
Angel that loses to Ein!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><38><31><00>Asgard needs an absolute
god...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><38><32><00>Someone like Master Hector!

<fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><38><33><00>I knew that if I left you\nto carry out your mission,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><36><34><61><5f><30><30><38><34><00>you'd defeat all the\nCefiro for me.
<fe><02><0a><36><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>But that Ledah guy was\nreally good, huh.
<fe><02><0a><36><37><32><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>The trunks are intertwining\nwith each other.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><37><32><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>It's like this is the root\nof all life.
<fe><02><0a><36><37><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>We have to protect the\nAquarium from Malice!
<fe><02><0a><36><37><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>We have no choice but\nto defeat them.
<fe><02><0a><36><37><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I can't believe Malice was\na Grim Angel...
<fe><02><0a><36><37><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>(She's a fearsome one at\nthat. Prepare yourself.)
<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>It's the place closest\nto Asgard.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><31><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>I can't believe it's\nmaterializing at Riviera...
<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>This atmosphere is too\nheavy for us Sprites.
<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>So this is the gate to\nthe Retribution...
<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>We don't know what will\nhappen. Be careful.
<fe><02><0a><36><38><32><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Too bad though... His shirt\nwas so comfortable...
